routesToMount.statement: Already included in the existing Team 17 interior-design router; no new global router registration required.

persistence.approvedSnapshot: Moodboard reads approved_* concept fields when review_state is approved_for_rendering and never mutates id_concept_drafts.

security: Admin-only through the global session/API-key middleware.
projectUuid is validated as UUID and resolved server-side against creative_projects.
Tenant context is resolved server-side; no tenantId is accepted from client input.
No provider key or secret is exposed to the frontend.
integrationNotes: Merge the OpenAPI fragment into the canonical spec before running codegen.
The service is deterministic and reuses an existing persisted moodboard unless force=true.
No new AI image provider or furniture placement mutation is introduced.
WP-09 Rendering Pipeline remains documentation-only and is not implemented here.
